_comment: Well-known built-in role definition GUIDs. Used only as a fallback. scripts/deploy.* resolves every one of these by display name at deploy time and exports the AKS_ROLE_* environment variables the parameter files read, because some tenants (CSP and managed tenants in particular) do not use the well-known GUIDs for every built-in role. Hardcoding them there fails with RoleDefinitionDoesNotExist.
